'''Sonny Dey''' (born '''Shannon Conley''') is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited as '''Ursula Conlon'''.

==Pokémon roles==
Dey began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[S09|the ninth season]], after {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]].
